Introduction

Hikaru is a Japanese rapper, dancer, and singer currently signed to Avex Management. She is best known as a member of the South Korean girl group Kep1er, formed through the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999.

Hikaru debuted as a member of Kep1er on January 3, 2022, with their first mini-album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group's debut was met with commercial success, marking the start of Hikaru's official career in the kpop industry.

Prior to her participation in Girls Planet 999, Hikaru was involved in the J-pop scene. In 2016, she debuted as a member of the J-pop project duo +GANG under Avex Artist Academy. During her time with the duo, she was known by the stage name "Hikarun." +GANG disbanded in 2018, but Hikaru remained an artist under Avex.

Hikaru also trained for the pre-debut group that later became XG, but she was eliminated from the final lineup in 2019.

In 2021, Hikaru joined Girls Planet 999 as a representative of the J-Group. She performed a cover of "Boombayah" by BLACKPINK for her evaluation performance, earning praise from the judges and securing her spot as a TOP9 candidate. Hikaru ranked 1st in her initial group and remained in the Planet Top 9 throughout the season. In the finale, she finished 7th with 713,322 points and 387,709 votes, earning her place in the final lineup of Kep1er.
